plugins.name: super-ralph
plugins.description: Design-first autonomous development workflow. /design produces implementation-ready epics with [STORY]/[BE]/[FE]/[INT] sub-issues. v0.11.0 adds --local mode (write entire plan to a single markdown file, skip GitHub) and /improve-design (single-prompt adjustments to existing designs). Fire-and-forget build → review → verify → release pipelines. Domain-aware repair with hotfix flow.

plugins.name: forth-ai-harness
plugins.description: Technical-cofounder-in-a-plugin for ForthAI Work. Twelve slash commands take a rough idea from discovery to a merged, deployed, polished product: /finit (setup) /fbrainstorm /fspec /fdesign /fbuild /fpolish /ftest /ffix /flaunch /fretro /fdream /fhelp. Each command is a convergence loop with polish-exhaustion enforced. Optional Claude+Codex dual-AI collaboration via --codex; works in Claude-only mode for users without Codex. Cross-project memory layer at ~/.claude/forth-ai-harness-memory/ auto-syncs to Forth-AI/forthai-harness-memory so /fdream learns across all your projects. Linear is SSoT; artifacts are AI-readable markdown.
